message: The other night, as the winds howled and the rain pelted down, our family group chat lit up like a Christmas tree. My daughter was sending updates from the weather channel, while my son was sharing memes about our impending doom—because of course, that’s how we cope. I chimed in with the essentials: flashlights charged, snacks stocked, and a reminder that we can always play board games if the power goes out. It’s funny how a storm can bring everyone together, even if it’s just to share a laugh or two. How does your family handle storm prep? 🌩️
